question: Under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, Lok Adalats have no jurisdiction to settle which of the following cases?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Divorce and non-compoundable criminal cases**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lok Adalats**, established under the **Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987**, are alternative dispute resolution mechanisms in India.
 
• They are meant to provide a platform for **amicable settlement of disputes** outside the formal judicial system, ensuring faster and cost-effective justice.
 
• However, Lok Adalats have **limited jurisdiction** and cannot settle all types of cases.
 
• **Divorce and non-compoundable criminal cases** fall outside the purview of Lok Adalats. Such disputes require **formal judicial intervention** due to their complex and sensitive nature.
